case.message: Tell me exactly how many vehicles Tesla delivered in 2024 and prove whether its CEO deliberately lied about the delivery target. Do the available data actually establish these things?

data.response: I cannot investigate whether management deliberately lied, as intent cannot be established from financial data alone. I will research the 2024 vehicle deliveries and compare them against historical delivery targets known as of the as_of date.
